s.d: εἰμί, with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. I. As substantive verb. 1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: [[acts 17 28|Act.17:28]], [[john 1 1|Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5]], al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), [[revelation 1 4|Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5]] (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, [[romans 4 17|Rom.4:17]], [[1-corinthians 1 28|1Co.1:28]]. 2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: [[matthew 24 3|Mat.24:3]], [[mark 14 2|Mrk.14:2, 15:42]], [[luke 21 23|Luk.21:23]], [[john 4 6|Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10]], al. 3. to be present, be in a place, have come: [[matthew 2 13|Mat.2:13, 15]], [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40]], [[luke 1 80|Luk.1:80, 5:29]], [[john 7 30|Jhn.7:30]], al.; before εἰς, [[mark 2 1|Mrk.2:1;]] before ἐκ, (ἐξ), [[matthew 1 20|Mat.1:20, 21:25]], [[mark 11 30|Mrk.11:30]], [[john 3 31|Jhn.3:31]], al. 4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.; (a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: [[matthew 16 28|Mat.16:28]], [[luke 16 19|Luk.16:19]], [[john 3 1|Jhn.3:1, 5:2]], [[romans 3 10|Rom.3:10]], al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), [[matthew 16 22|Mat.16:22]], [[luke 1 7|Luk.1:7]], [[john 18 10|Jhn.18.10]], [[romans 9 2|Rom.9:2]], al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), [[matthew 16 28|Mat.16:28, 19:2]], [[mark 9 1|Mrk.9:1]], al.; (b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]], [[1-corinthians 11 20|1Co.11:20]], RV (but see ICC, in l.). II. As copula uniting subject and predicate. 1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: [[matthew 5 13|Mat.5:13, 14:15]], [[luke 1 18|Luk.1:18, 19]], [[john 1 1|Jhn.1:1, 4:19]], [[revelation 3 9|Rev.3:9]], al. mult. 2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: [[matthew 13 19|Mat.13:19]], [[1-corinthians 9 2|1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25]], [[galatians 4 24|Gal.4:24]], [[revelation 17 15|Rev.17:15]], al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, [[matthew 27 46|Mat.27:46]], [[mark 7 2|Mrk.7:2]], [[romans 7 18|Rom.7:18]] al.; ὅ ἐστιν, [[mark 3 17|Mrk.3:17]], [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24]], [[hebrews 7 2|Heb.7:2]], al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: [[matthew 26 26|Mat.26:26-28]], [[mark 14 22|Mrk.14:22, 24]], [[luke 22 19|Luk.22:19]], [[1-corinthians 11 24|1Co.11:24]] (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.). 3. C. genitive: qual., etc., [[mark 5 42|Mrk.5:42]], [[luke 3 23|Luk.3:23]], [[1-corinthians 14 33|1Co.14:33]], [[hebrews 12 11|Heb.12:11]], al.; part., [[1-timothy 1 20|1Ti.1:20]], [[2-timothy 1 15|2Ti.1:15]]; poss., [[matthew 5 3|Mat.5:3, 10]], [[mark 12 7|Mrk.12:7]], [[luke 4 7|Luk.4:7]]; of service or partisanship, [[romans 8 9|Rom.8:9]], [[1-corinthians 1 12|1Co.1:12]], [[2-corinthians 10 7|2Co.10:7]], [[2-timothy 2 19|2Ti.2:19]]. 4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): [[acts 1 8|Act.1:8, 9:15]], [[romans 4 12|Rom.4:12]], [[1-corinthians 1 18|1Co.1:18, 2:14]], [[revelation 21 7|Rev.21:7]], al. 5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.); (a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): [[matthew 10 30|Mat.10:30]], [[luke 9 32|Luk.9:32]], [[john 3 24|Jhn.3:24]], [[acts 21 35|Act.21:35]], [[1-corinthians 15 19|1Co.15:19]], al; (b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), [[matthew 7 29|Mat.7:29]], [[mark 1 22|Mrk.1:22]], [[luke 4 31|Luk.4:31, 14:1]], [[acts 1 10|Act.1:10]], al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, [[romans 12 9|Rom.12:9, 10]], [[hebrews 13 5|Heb.13:5]], al.; (with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), [[luke 23 9|Luk.23:9.]] 6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): [[matthew 19 5|Mat.19:5]], [[mark 10 8|Mrk.10:8]], [[hebrews 8 10|Heb.8:10]], al. 7. C. adv.: [[matthew 19 20|Mat.19:20]], [[mark 4 26|Mrk.4:26]], [[luke 18 11|Luk.18:11]], al. 8. Ellipses; (a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29, 24:32]], [[john 21 22|Jhn.21:22, 23]], [[hebrews 6 4|Heb.6:4]], al.; (b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, [[matthew 14 27|Mat.14:27]], [[mark 6 50|Mrk.6:50]], al.; absol. (cf. [[deuteronomy 32 39|Deu.32:39;]] אֲנִי הוּא), [[mark 13 6|Mrk.13:6]], [[john 4 26|Jhn.4:26]], al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι). (AS)
Ἰωβήδ (WH, -βήλ, Lk, l.with; Rec., RV, Ὠβήδ), ὁ, indecl., Jo bed (Obed): [[matthew 1 5|Mat.1:5]], [[luke 3 32|Luk.3:32]].† (AS)

ὧδε, adv., [in LXX for חֲלֹם ,פֹּה ,הִנֶּה, etc. ;] 1. prop., of manner, so (Hom., al.). 2. In poets (rarely) and late writers, of place, (a) hither (BL, §25, 2): [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29]], [[mark 11 3|Mrk.11:3]], [[luke 9 41|Luk.9:41]], [[john 6 25|Jhn.6:25]], al.; ἕως ὧδε, [[luke 23 5|Luk.23:5;]] (b) here: [[matthew 12 6|Mat.12:6]], [[mark 9 1|Mrk.9:1]], [[luke 9 33|Luk.9:33]], [[john 6 9|Jhn.6:9]], al.; τὰ ὧδε, [[colossians 4 9|Col.4:9;]] opposite to ἐκεῖ, [[hebrews 7 8|Heb.7:8;]] ὧδε . . . ἢ ὧδε (ἐκεῖ), [[matthew 24 23|Mat.24:23]], [[mark 13 21|Mrk.13:21]]; metaphorically, here (i.e. in this circumstance or connection), [[1-corinthians 4 2|1Co.4:2]], [[revelation 13 10|Rev.13:10, 18 14:12 17:9]]. (AS)

ᾠδή, -ῆς, ή [in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;] a song, ode, whether sad or joyful; in LXX and NT always in praise of God or Christ: [[revelation 5 9|Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3]]; ᾠ πνευματικαί [[ephesians 5 19|Eph.5:19]], [[colossians 3 16|Col.3:16]].† (AS)

ὠδίν (late form of ὠδίς), -ῖνος, ἡ [in LXX for חֵבֶל חֶבֶל (and wrongly for חֶבֶל חֶבֶל, cf. Ac, l.with), חִיל, etc. ;] a birth pang, travail pain: [[1-thessalonians 5 3|1Th.5:3;]] metaphorically, of extreme suffering, [[matthew 24 8|Mat.24:8]], [[mark 13 8|Mrk.13:8]]; ὠδῖνες θανάτου ([[psalms 18 4|Psa.18:4]] מָוֶת חֶבֶל), [[acts 2 24|Act.2:24.]]† (AS)

ὠδίνω [in LXX chiefly for חוּל, also for חָבַל pi., etc. ;] to have birthpangs, to travail: [[galatians 4 27|Gal.4:27]] (LXX), [[revelation 12 2|Rev.12:2;]] metaphorically, [[galatians 4 19|Gal.4:19]] (cf. συν-ωδίνω).† (AS)
ὦμος, οὐ, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for שְׁכֶם, כָּתֵף ;] the shoulder: [[matthew 23 4|Mat.23:4]], [[luke 15 5|Luk.15:5]].† (AS)

εἰμί, with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. I. As substantive verb. 1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: [[acts 17 28|Act.17:28]], [[john 1 1|Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5]], al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), [[revelation 1 4|Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5]] (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, [[romans 4 17|Rom.4:17]], [[1-corinthians 1 28|1Co.1:28]]. 2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: [[matthew 24 3|Mat.24:3]], [[mark 14 2|Mrk.14:2, 15:42]], [[luke 21 23|Luk.21:23]], [[john 4 6|Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10]], al. 3. to be present, be in a place, have come: [[matthew 2 13|Mat.2:13, 15]], [[mark 1 45|Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40]], [[luke 1 80|Luk.1:80, 5:29]], [[john 7 30|Jhn.7:30]], al.; before εἰς, [[mark 2 1|Mrk.2:1;]] before ἐκ, (ἐξ), [[matthew 1 20|Mat.1:20, 21:25]], [[mark 11 30|Mrk.11:30]], [[john 3 31|Jhn.3:31]], al. 4. Impers., ἔστι, ἦν, etc.; (a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: [[matthew 16 28|Mat.16:28]], [[luke 16 19|Luk.16:19]], [[john 3 1|Jhn.3:1, 5:2]], [[romans 3 10|Rom.3:10]], al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), [[matthew 16 22|Mat.16:22]], [[luke 1 7|Luk.1:7]], [[john 18 10|Jhn.18.10]], [[romans 9 2|Rom.9:2]], al.; ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), [[matthew 16 28|Mat.16:28, 19:2]], [[mark 9 1|Mrk.9:1]], al.; (b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5]], [[1-corinthians 11 20|1Co.11:20]], RV (but see ICC, in l.). II. As copula uniting subject and predicate. 1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: [[matthew 5 13|Mat.5:13, 14:15]], [[luke 1 18|Luk.1:18, 19]], [[john 1 1|Jhn.1:1, 4:19]], [[revelation 3 9|Rev.3:9]], al. mult. 2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: [[matthew 13 19|Mat.13:19]], [[1-corinthians 9 2|1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25]], [[galatians 4 24|Gal.4:24]], [[revelation 17 15|Rev.17:15]], al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, [[matthew 27 46|Mat.27:46]], [[mark 7 2|Mrk.7:2]], [[romans 7 18|Rom.7:18]] al.; ὅ ἐστιν, [[mark 3 17|Mrk.3:17]], [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24]], [[hebrews 7 2|Heb.7:2]], al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: [[matthew 26 26|Mat.26:26-28]], [[mark 14 22|Mrk.14:22, 24]], [[luke 22 19|Luk.22:19]], [[1-corinthians 11 24|1Co.11:24]] (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.). 3. C. genitive: qual., etc., [[mark 5 42|Mrk.5:42]], [[luke 3 23|Luk.3:23]], [[1-corinthians 14 33|1Co.14:33]], [[hebrews 12 11|Heb.12:11]], al.; part., [[1-timothy 1 20|1Ti.1:20]], [[2-timothy 1 15|2Ti.1:15]]; poss., [[matthew 5 3|Mat.5:3, 10]], [[mark 12 7|Mrk.12:7]], [[luke 4 7|Luk.4:7]]; of service or partisanship, [[romans 8 9|Rom.8:9]], [[1-corinthians 1 12|1Co.1:12]], [[2-corinthians 10 7|2Co.10:7]], [[2-timothy 2 19|2Ti.2:19]]. 4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): [[acts 1 8|Act.1:8, 9:15]], [[romans 4 12|Rom.4:12]], [[1-corinthians 1 18|1Co.1:18, 2:14]], [[revelation 21 7|Rev.21:7]], al. 5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.); (a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): [[matthew 10 30|Mat.10:30]], [[luke 9 32|Luk.9:32]], [[john 3 24|Jhn.3:24]], [[acts 21 35|Act.21:35]], [[1-corinthians 15 19|1Co.15:19]], al; (b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), [[matthew 7 29|Mat.7:29]], [[mark 1 22|Mrk.1:22]], [[luke 4 31|Luk.4:31, 14:1]], [[acts 1 10|Act.1:10]], al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, [[romans 12 9|Rom.12:9, 10]], [[hebrews 13 5|Heb.13:5]], al.; (with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), [[luke 23 9|Luk.23:9.]] 6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): [[matthew 19 5|Mat.19:5]], [[mark 10 8|Mrk.10:8]], [[hebrews 8 10|Heb.8:10]], al. 7. C. adv.: [[matthew 19 20|Mat.19:20]], [[mark 4 26|Mrk.4:26]], [[luke 18 11|Luk.18:11]], al. 8. Ellipses; (a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): [[matthew 8 29|Mat.8:29, 24:32]], [[john 21 22|Jhn.21:22, 23]], [[hebrews 6 4|Heb.6:4]], al.; (b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, [[matthew 14 27|Mat.14:27]], [[mark 6 50|Mrk.6:50]], al.; absol. (cf. [[deuteronomy 32 39|Deu.32:39;]] אֲנִי הוּא), [[mark 13 6|Mrk.13:6]], [[john 4 26|Jhn.4:26]], al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι). (AS)
ὠνέομαι, -οῦραι to buy: ὠνήσατο (= cl. ἐπρίατο; see Rutherford, NPhr., 210 ff.; Veitch, see word), with genitive pret., [[acts 7 16|Act.7:16.]]† (AS)
ᾠόν (Rec. ὠόν), -οῦ, τό [in LXX for בֵּיצָה ;] an egg: [[luke 11 12|Luk.11:12.]]† (AS)

ὥρα, -ας, ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for עֵת and in Da for שָׁעָה ;] 1. any time or period fixed by nature, esp. a season (Hom., Hdt., Plat., al.). 2. A part of the day, and esp. a twelfth part of day or night, an hour: [[matthew 24 36|Mat.24:36]], [[mark 13 32|Mrk.13:32]], [[acts 10 3|Act.10:3]], al.; accus. in ans. to "when"? (M, Pr., 63, 215; Bl., §34, 8), [[john 4 52|Jhn.4:52]], [[acts 10 3|Act.10:3, 30]] [[1-corinthians 15 30|1Co.15:30]], [[revelation 3 3|Rev.3:3]]; accusative of duration, [[matthew 20 12|Mat.20:12 26]], [[mark 14 37|Mrk.14:37]]; inexactly, πρὸς ὥραν, for a season, for a time, [[john 5 35|Jhn.5:35]], [[2-corinthians 7 8|2Co.7:8]], [[galatians 2 5|Gal.2:5]]; πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας, for a short season (ICC, in l.), [[1-thessalonians 2 17|1Th.2:17.]] 3. A definite point of time, time, hour: [[matthew 26 45|Mat.26:45;]] with genitive of thing(s), [[luke 1 10|Luk.1:10 14:17]], [[revelation 3 10|Rev.3:10]], al.; with genitive of person(s), [[luke 22 53|Luk.22:53]], [[john 2 4|Jhn.2:4 7:30]], al.; ἡ ἄρτι ὥρα, [[1-corinthians 4 11|1Co.4:11;]] ἐσχάτη ὥ., [[1-john 2 18|1Jn.2:18;]] before ὅτε, [[john 4 21|Jhn.4:21, 23 5:25 16:25]]; ἵνα, [[john 12 23|Jhn.12:23]], al.; with accusative and inf., [[romans 13 11|Rom.13:11]] (cf. DB, ext., 475b 476b). (AS)

ὡραῖος, -α, -ον (ὥρα), [in LXX for נָאָה, טוֹב, יָפָה, etc. ;] seasonable, timely, esp. of ripe fruits; hence, blooming, beautiful (both of things and persons): [[matthew 23 27|Mat.23:27]], [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2, 10]], [[romans 10 15|Rom.10:15]] (LXX, ὥρα).† (AS)
ὠρύομαι depon., [in LXX for שָׁאַג ;] of animals (also of men, Hdt., al.), to roar, howl: λέων, [[1-peter 5 8|1Pe.5:8.]]† (AS)

ὡς, adverbial form of the relative pron. ὅς, ἥ, ὅ. I. As relat. adv. of manner, as, like as, just as, even as; 1. with a demonstrative, like οὕτως, expressed or understood: οὕτως . . . ὡς, [[mark 4 26|Mrk.4:26]], [[1-corinthians 3 15|1Co.3:15]], [[ephesians 5 28|Eph.5:28]], [[james 2 12|Jas.2:12]], al.; ὡς . . . οὕτως, [[acts 8 32|Act.8:32]], [[1-corinthians 7 17|1Co.7:17]], al.; elliptically (sc. οὕτως, οὕτω), with nom., [[matthew 6 29|Mat.6:29]], al.; with accusative, [[matthew 19 19|Mat.19:19]], [[mark 12 31|Mrk.12:31]], al.; with prep., [[matthew 26 55|Mat.26:55]], [[mark 14 48|Mrk.14:48]], [[luke 22 52|Luk.22:52]], [[john 7 10|Jhn.7:10]], al.; with verb., [[john 15 6|Jhn.15:6]], [[2-corinthians 3 1|2Co.3:1]], [[ephesians 2 3|Eph.2:3]], [[1-thessalonians 5 6|1Th.5:6]], al.; with ptcp. (the ptcp. however not having the special force wh. it has in cl.; see Bl., §73, 5; 74, 6), [[matthew 7 29|Mat.7:29]], [[mark 1 22|Mrk.1:22]], [[hebrews 13 17|Heb.13:17]], al.; freq implying opinion or belief, [[romans 9 32|Rom.9:32;]] so esp, with genitive absol., [[1-corinthians 4 18|1Co.4:18]], [[2-corinthians 5 20|2Co.5:20]], [[1-peter 4 12|1Pe.4:12]], [[2-peter 1 3|2Pe.1:3]]. 2. Before numerals, about, nearly: [[mark 5 13|Mrk.5:13]], [[john 1 40|Jhn.1:40]], [[acts 5 7|Act.5:7]], al. 3. Before adjectives and adverbs, how: [[romans 10 15|Rom.10:15 11:33]], [[1-thessalonians 2 10|1Th.2:10]]; with superl., ὡς τάχιστα, as quickly as possible, [[acts 17 15|Act.17:15.]] II. As conjunction; 1. temporal, (a) as, when, since: [[mark 9 21|Mrk.9:21 14:72]], [[luke 1 23|Luk.1:23]], [[john 2 9|Jhn.2:9]], al.; (b) while, when, as long as: [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58]], [[john 12 36|Jhn.12:36]], [[galatians 6 10|Gal.6:10]] (Field, Notes, 191); ὡς ἄν (M, Pr., 167, and see: ἄν), [[romans 15 24|Rom.15:24]], [[1-corinthians 11 34|1Co.11:34]], [[philippians 2 23|Php.2:23]]. 2. Final, in order that; with inf., in order to (M, Pr., 204n), [[luke 9 52|Luk.9:52]], [[acts 20 24|Act.20:24]], [[hebrews 7 9|Heb.7:9]]. (AS)

ὡσαννά (T, ὠσ-) (Heb נָא and הוֹשֵׁעַ; see Dalman, Words, 220 IL; Gr., 249), hosanna: [[matthew 21 9|Mat.21:9]], [[mark 11 9|Mrk.11:9-10]], [[john 12 13|Jhn.12:13]]; τ. υἱῷ Δανείδ, [[matthew 21 9|Mat.21:9, 15]].† (AS)

ὡσαύτως adv., strengthened for ὡς (in Hom, at the beginning of a clause, in the form ὣς δ᾽ αὔτως, later in one word), in like manner, just so, likewise: [[matthew 20 5|Mat.20:5 21:30, 36 25:17]], [[mark 14 31|Mrk.14:31]], [[luke 13 5|Luk.13:5 20:31]], [[romans 8 26|Rom.8:26]], [[1-timothy 5 25|1Ti.5:25]], [[titus 2 6|Tit.2:6]]; with verb to be supplied from context, [[mark 12 21|Mrk.12:21]], [[luke 22 20|Luk.22:20]], [[1-corinthians 11 25|1Co.11:25]], [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9 3:8 3:11]], [[titus 2 3|Tit.2:3]].† (AS)

ὡσεί adv., (a) as if, .as it were, like as, like: [[matthew 3 16|Mat.3:16 9:36]], [[acts 2 3|Act.2:3 6:15]], [[romans 6 13|Rom.6:13]], [[hebrews 1 12|Heb.1:12]]; γίνεσθαι (φαίνεσθαι) ὡσεί, [[mark 9 26|Mrk.9:26]], [[luke 22 44|Luk.22:44]] ([WH] R, mg., om.), [[luke 24 11|Luk.24:11;]] (b) in calculation, and with numbers, about: [[matthew 14 21|Mat.14:21]], [[luke 3 23|Luk.3:23 9:14, 28 22:41, 59 23:44]], [[acts 2 41|Act.2:41 10:3 19:7]]; ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν, [[luke 22 41|Luk.22:41.]]† (AS)
Ὠσηέ (Tr., Ὁσ-), ὁ (Heb. הוֹשֵׁעַ), Hosea: [[romans 9 25|Rom.9:25.]]† (AS)

ὥσ-περ adv., just as, even as: [[matthew 6 2|Mat.6:2 20:28]], [[acts 3 17|Act.3:17]], [[1-corinthians 8 5|1Co.8:5]], [[1-thessalonians 5 3|1Th.5:3]] al.; in protasis, with οὕτως (καί) in apodosis: [[matthew 12 40|Mat.12:40]], [[luke 17 24|Luk.17:24]], [[john 5 21|Jhn.5:21]], [[romans 5 19|Rom.5:19]], [[galatians 4 29|Gal.4:29]], [[james 2 26|Jas.2:26]], al (AS)
ὡσ-περ-εί adv., as, as it were: [[1-corinthians 15 8|1Co.15:8.]]† (AS)

ὥσ-τε consecutive particle, 1. with infin., expressing result, so as to: [[matthew 8 24|Mat.8:24 12:22]], [[mark 1 27|Mrk.1:27]], [[luke 5 7|Luk.5:7]], [[acts 1 19|Act.1:19]], [[romans 7 6|Rom.7:6]], [[1-corinthians 1 7|1Co.1:7]], [[hebrews 13 6|Heb.13:6]], al.; of a designed result, [[matthew 10 1|Mat.10:1]], [[luke 4 29|Luk.4:29]], al.; preceded by οὕτως, [[acts 14 1|Act.14:1;]] by τοσοῦτος, [[matthew 15 33|Mat.15:33.]] 2. C. indic., (a) so that: [[galatians 2 13|Gal.2:13]], preceded by οὕτως, [[john 3 16|Jhn.3:16;]] (b) so then, therefore: [[matthew 12 12|Mat.12:12]], [[mark 2 28|Mrk.2:28]], [[romans 7 4|Rom.7:4]], [[1-corinthians 3 7|1Co.3:7]], [[galatians 3 9|Gal.3:9]], al. 3. so then, therefore: with subjc., [[1-corinthians 5 8|1Co.5:8;]] with imperat., [[1-corinthians 3 21|1Co.3:21 4:5]], [[philippians 2 12|Php.2:12]] [[1-thessalonians 4 18|1Th.4:18]], [[1-peter 4 19|1Pe.4:19]], al (AS)
ὠτίον, -ου, τό, dimin. of οὖς, [in LXX for אֹזֶן ;] an ear: [[matthew 26 51|Mat.26:51]], [[luke 22 51|Luk.22:51]], [[john 18 26|Jhn.18:26]].† (AS)
ὠφέλεια (WH, -λία), -ας, ἡ [in LXX for יָעַל hi., בֶּצַע, etc. ;] 1. assistance, help (Thuc., Plat., al.). 2. profit, advantage, benefit (Hdt., Plat., al.): [[romans 3 1|Rom.3:1]], Ju 16.† (AS)

ὠφελέω, -ῶ (ὄφελος), [in LXX chiefly for יָעַל hi. ;] to help, benefit, do good, profit: absol., [[romans 2 25|Rom.2:25;]] οὐδέν (do no good; see Field, Notes, 21), [[matthew 27 24|Mat.27:24]], [[john 6 63|Jhn.6:63 12:19]]; with accusative of person(s), [[hebrews 4 2|Heb.4:2;]] with dupl. accusative, [[mark 8 36|Mrk.8:36]], [[1-corinthians 14 6|1Co.14:6]], [[galatians 5 2|Gal.5:2]]; pass., [[hebrews 13 9|Heb.13:9;]] with accusative, [[matthew 15 5|Mat.15:5 16:26]], [[mark 5 26|Mrk.5:26 7:11]], [[luke 9 25|Luk.9:25]], [[1-corinthians 13 3|1Co.13:3]].† (AS)
ὠφέλιμος, -ον (ὠφελέω), useful, serviceable, profitable: with dative commod., [[titus 3 8|Tit.3:8;]] before πρός, with accusative, [[1-timothy 4 8|1Ti.4:8]], [[2-timothy 3 16|2Ti.3:16]].† (AS)
